reasons.text: The label is legible and shows REV 12 Kids Bike, a recalled model.
The claimed purchase date of 2021-11-22 is before the sale window of 2022-03-01 to 2024-05-31, so the purchase does not qualify even though the retailer (REI.com) is listed.
The date code 2025 is outside the recalled range of model years 2022-2024, which is a further mismatch with the recall.
The serial 01VX56532856 is within the recalled serial ranges, but this does not offset the purchase and date code failures.
No duplicate claims were found for this photo, address, serial, or payout account.
